decision_contract.execution: A target formed at boundary t uses only closed rows available at t and is filled by the central evaluator at the next executable open with ordinary costs and capacity limits.

strategy_outputs.flat: {} at a scheduled boundary when state, history, funding, cross-sectional scale, signed tails, or allocation is invalid
strategy_outputs.hold: None outside the daily scheduled boundary
strategy_outputs.targets: finite signed unlevered weights for current eligible symbols only

forward_diagnostics.availability: Outcome only; never an input to a target at t.
forward_diagnostics.embargo: One 24-hour holding interval for any training-prefix diagnostic.
forward_diagnostics.label_window: Executable open following decision t through the following daily executable open.
forward_diagnostics.overlap_rule: Daily labels are non-overlapping; purge a label whose endpoint reaches a fold boundary.
forward_diagnostics.purpose: Optional state-score diagnostics only; the pivot falsifier makes no unmeasured IC claim.

forward_diagnostics.availability: Outcome only; calculated centrally from canonical fills and costs.
forward_diagnostics.embargo: Not applicable to accounting; chronological folds are separate cutoff-safe replays.
forward_diagnostics.label_window: Central evaluator return interval after the next-open target fill.
forward_diagnostics.overlap_rule: Assigned by evaluator timestamp to canonical fold and regime.
forward_diagnostics.purpose: Reference falsifier, role gates, qualification, and any later selection metric.

invariance_tests.test: mutate only BTC close at decision_time after preserving the exact t-1d anchor

mechanism_identity_guardrail.allowed_state_switch: raw asset trend only in the causally lagged bear state; BTC-residual continuation in bull and chop
forbidden_without_second_formal_pivot: different regime thresholds, lag, market factor, or state labels
reversal rather than continuation in any state
risk controls on a reference that failed its causal or role gates
simultaneous signal, funding, construction, and risk redesign
mechanism_identity_guardrail.identity: one-day-lagged BTC regime-conditional path-efficient trend with unchanged funding de-crowding

missing_data_policy.bars: No forward fill or full-sample imputation. Exclude a symbol failing finite-positive close, consecutive-return, state-slice, or paired-BTC coverage.
missing_data_policy.cross_section: Require at least 24 valid symbols and six signed names per side. Otherwise request flat; never transfer unused gross to one sleeve.
missing_data_policy.funding: Require at least 14 finite actual events in [t-7d,t). No row at or after t and no imputation.
missing_data_policy.market_factor: Require BTCUSDT, exact closes at t-1d and t-61d, valid 30-day paired coverage, and variance above 1e-12. Request flat rather than substitute a factor or neutral state.
missing_data_policy.robust_scale: Request flat when either current-cross-section MAD is non-finite or <=1e-12; no fallback scale.

raw_inputs.availability_timestamp: A bar is delivered only when open_time + 8h <= decision_time.
raw_inputs.coverage: Closed 8h rows for current eligible symbols; the regime needs exact BTC closes at t-1d and t-61d, beta needs 72 paired returns, and signal needs the complete H14/K3 slice.
raw_inputs.lag: Signal slice ends t-3d; BTC state and tilt end t-1d; execution remains next-open.
raw_inputs.missing_rule: Exclude non-finite, non-positive, duplicate, non-monotone, gapped, or insufficient history; do not forward fill.
raw_inputs.source: Frozen public Binance USD-M 8h transaction-bar snapshot through the authorized stage cutoff.

raw_inputs.availability_timestamp: Strictly after the completed event; worker admits only funding_time < decision_time.
raw_inputs.coverage: Actual event rows for current eligible symbols; at least 14 finite events in seven calendar days.
raw_inputs.missing_rule: Exclude the symbol; do not impute zero or a scheduled rate.
raw_inputs.source: Frozen public Binance USD-M actual funding rows through the authorized stage cutoff.

raw_inputs.availability_timestamp: Effective at the current decision boundary and delivered by the organizer.
raw_inputs.coverage: Point-in-time Top-40 intersected with contracts having an executable next open.
raw_inputs.lag: The strategy consumes only the authorized current membership.
raw_inputs.missing_rule: Never synthesize membership or return targets outside the delivered set.
raw_inputs.source: Organizer-owned point-in-time universe from the frozen public snapshot.

transforms.availability: At t after both adjacent closes have closed and been delivered.
transforms.lag: No return is formed across a missing 8h interval.
transforms.missing_rule: Invalid across gaps or non-positive closes.

transforms.availability: At decision t from exact BTC closes ending one calendar day earlier.
transforms.formula: g_t=log(C_BTC,t-1d/C_BTC,t-61d); bull if g_t>=0.10, bear if g_t<=-0.10, else chop; m_t=clip(g_t/0.20,-1,1)
transforms.lag: Both state and direction tilt end at t-1d.
transforms.missing_rule: Request flat if either exact close is missing or invalid; do not substitute chop or zero.

transforms.availability: Recomputed at every t from paired closed returns.
transforms.fit_scope: Past-only rolling 30 days; no fold-spanning object.
transforms.lag: Window ends no later than t; minimum 72 paired returns.
transforms.missing_rule: Invalid on insufficient coverage or BTC variance <=1e-12.

transforms.availability: At t after the lagged state and H14/K3 return slice are valid.
transforms.fit_scope: Fixed H=14 days, K=3 days, gamma=0.5 for the reference.
transforms.formula: x_i,u=r_i,u-beta_i(t)r_BTC,u in bull/chop and x_i,u=r_i,u in bear; U_i=[sum(x)/(sd(x)*sqrt(42))]*[abs(sum(x))/sum(abs(x))]^0.5
transforms.missing_rule: Invalid on incomplete slice, non-finite value, sample sd <=1e-12, or path denominator <=1e-8.

transforms.availability: At t using actual events strictly before t.
transforms.missing_rule: Invalid with fewer than 14 finite events.

transforms.availability: At t over the valid current eligible cross-section.
transforms.lag: Inherits H14/K3 price and strict funding lags.
transforms.missing_rule: Request flat when either MAD fails or valid cross-section <24.

transforms.availability: At scheduled t after score, state, and coverage checks.
transforms.fit_scope: Reference-fixed q=0.25 and delta=0.075; deterministic current-slice weighting.
transforms.formula: rank signed tails; long gross=0.40+0.075*m_t, short magnitude=0.40-0.075*m_t, total gross=0.80, symbol cap=0.09
inputs: sample volatility of the state-specific signal return
transforms.lag: Formed at t and filled only at the next executable open.
transforms.missing_rule: Request flat if either side has fewer than six signed names or capped-simplex projection is infeasible.
